claude_proposed_widenings.name: DurationKindUpcastTier
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Upcast at slot 4+ changes the duration KIND (concentration → permanent/until-dispelled) rather than just the amount. DurationUpcastTier only allows changing the numeric amount within the same duration kind. A new upcast variant is needed to express 'at slot N, switch to a different Duration family entirely.'
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot (4+): The spell lasts until dispelled, without requiring Concentration.
